sentences.text: [deadpan, dry humor] Your phone's at three percent, and a lion just walked out of that gate.
The crowd runs for a tunnel marked vomitorium.
You know this one. Rich Romans threw up in there, so they could keep eating.
You hit the flashlight, and it's just a hallway.
There isn't any. A vomitorium was the exit.
Vomit means spew. It spewed crowds onto the street.
Victorian writers made the puke room up.
Romans did throw up at feasts, though.
One writer said they vomit so they can eat, and eat so they can vomit.
Then the tunnel spews you out at the guards' feet. One percent.
[after a long pause] [lowering their voice] Comment ESCAPE for part five.
